                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body cache result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">Start</h2>
<p>最近公司要求所有的开发，无论是前端后端还是测开一律转成全栈，在Agent的辅助下转型，没招了，之前还有点精神洁癖想保持纯洁性的，这下真没招了，那就搞吧，出去面试还能多点钱呢，现在公司这里拿着前端的钱干着全栈的活搞几天吧，后面一定要跑路的🏃。</p>
<p>其实全栈这件事情没这么难，我说实话，再有了一定的语言基础之后，哪怕js和java一个是强类型语言一个是弱类型语言，但是前端其实很少用纯js写东西，都是ts，该有的东西其实都有，概念都知道是啥意思，无非就是换个语法形式写。如果之前做过node，尤其是用过像nest或者midway框架写过服务端，你会发现其实Spring什么的也就那样了，不要怕，上手写一下就好了，尤其是现在有AI，看不懂的就问AI，写不来的就AI写，反正要有后端帮你CR，大不了搞几个故障出来，让上面的老板知道一下半吊子全栈的厉害，顺手领个大礼包跑路这不是美滋滋～</p>
<p>好了，下面进入正文：</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">前端工程师的 Java 后端快速入门指南</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>这是一份专为有 JavaScript 基础的前端工程师准备的 Java 后端入门教程。我会用你熟悉的 JS 概念来对比讲解，帮你快速建立认知。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">一、学习路线总览</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-arduino" lang="arduino">阶段一：Java 语言基础（<span class="hljs-number">1</span><span class="hljs-number">-2</span> 周）
├── 环境搭建（JDK + IDEA + Maven）
├── 基础语法（变量、类型、控制流）
├── 面向对象（类、接口、继承、多态）
└── 进阶特性（泛型、集合、异常、Lambda、<span class="hljs-built_in">Stream</span>）

阶段二：构建工具与生态（<span class="hljs-number">3</span><span class="hljs-number">-5</span> 天）
├── Maven / Gradle（类似 npm）
└── 依赖管理与项目结构

阶段三：核心框架（<span class="hljs-number">2</span><span class="hljs-number">-3</span> 周）
├── Spring / Spring Boot（核心，类似 Express 全家桶）
├── MyBatis / MyBatis-Plus（操作数据库，类似 ORM）
└── Spring MVC（写接口）

阶段四：实战配套（持续）
├── 数据库（MySQL）
├── Redis（缓存）
├── 接口测试（Postman）
└── 部署（Docker、服务器）
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">二、环境搭建（先动手）</h3>

























<table><thead><tr><th>工具</th><th>作用</th><th>前端类比</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>JDK 17+</td><td>Java 运行环境和编译器</td><td>Node.js</td></tr><tr><td>IntelliJ IDEA</td><td>开发工具（社区版免费）</td><td>VS Code</td></tr><tr><td>Maven</td><td>包管理 + 构建工具</td><td>npm + webpack</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>安装 JDK 后，验证：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">java -version
javac -version
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">三、语法对比：从 JS 到 Java</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">核心区别先认知</h4>






























<table><thead><tr><th>维度</th><th>JavaScript</th><th>Java</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>类型系统</td><td>动态弱类型</td><td>静态强类型（必须声明类型）</td></tr><tr><td>运行方式</td><td>解释执行</td><td>先编译成字节码再运行</td></tr><tr><td>一切皆…</td><td>一切皆对象（函数也是）</td><td>一切皆类（代码必须在类里）</td></tr><tr><td>分号</td><td>可选</td><td>必须</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">1. 变量声明</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// JavaScript</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> name = <span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> age = <span class="hljs-number">18</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">var</span> flag = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> num = <span class="hljs-number">3.14</span>;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Java：必须先声明类型</span>
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">name</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>;        <span class="hljs-comment">// 字符串</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">age</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">18</span>;          <span class="hljs-comment">// final = JS 的 const</span>
<span class="hljs-type">boolean</span> <span class="hljs-variable">flag</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
<span class="hljs-type">double</span> <span class="hljs-variable">num</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">3.14</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// Java 10+ 也支持类型推断（但仍是静态类型）</span>
<span class="hljs-type">var</span> <span class="hljs-variable">city</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-string">"北京"</span>;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 编译器自动推断为 String</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">2. 基本数据类型（这是 JS 没有的概念）</h4>
<p>JS 只有 <code>number</code>，Java 把数字分得很细：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// 整数类</span>
<span class="hljs-type">byte</span>  <span class="hljs-variable">b</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;        <span class="hljs-comment">// 1字节</span>
<span class="hljs-type">short</span> <span class="hljs-variable">s</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">2</span>;        <span class="hljs-comment">// 2字节</span>
<span class="hljs-type">int</span>   <span class="hljs-variable">i</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">100</span>;      <span class="hljs-comment">// 4字节，最常用</span>
<span class="hljs-type">long</span>  <span class="hljs-variable">l</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">100L</span>;     <span class="hljs-comment">// 8字节，注意加 L</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 浮点</span>
<span class="hljs-type">float</span>  <span class="hljs-variable">f</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">1.5f</span>;    <span class="hljs-comment">// 注意加 f</span>
<span class="hljs-type">double</span> <span class="hljs-variable">d</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">3.14</span>;    <span class="hljs-comment">// 最常用的小数类型</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 其他</span>
<span class="hljs-type">char</span>    <span class="hljs-variable">c</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-string">'A'</span>;    <span class="hljs-comment">// 单个字符，用单引号</span>
<span class="hljs-type">boolean</span> <span class="hljs-variable">flag</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>关键点</strong>：基本类型（小写 int）和包装类型（大写 Integer）的区别。
集合、泛型里必须用包装类型：<code>List&lt;Integer&gt;</code> 而不是 <code>List&lt;int&gt;</code>。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">3. 字符串</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// JS</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> s = <span class="hljs-string">"hello"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> str = <span class="hljs-string">`你好 <span class="hljs-subst">${name}</span>`</span>;       <span class="hljs-comment">// 模板字符串</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> len = s.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>;            <span class="hljs-comment">// 属性</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Java：String 是一个类，length() 是方法</span>
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">s</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-string">"hello"</span>;
<span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">len</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> s.length();           <span class="hljs-comment">// 注意是方法，要括号</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 拼接</span>
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">str</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-string">"你好 "</span> + name;

<span class="hljs-comment">// Java 15+ 文本块（类似模板字符串的多行）</span>
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">json</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-string">"""
    {
        "name": "张三"
    }
    """</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 字符串格式化</span>
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">msg</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> String.format(<span class="hljs-string">"你好 %s，今年 %d 岁"</span>, name, age);
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-9">4. 控制流（基本一样）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// if-else 一致</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (age &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">18</span>) {
    System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"成年"</span>);
} <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"未成年"</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// for 循环一致</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">i</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; <span class="hljs-number">10</span>; i++) {
    System.out.println(i);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 增强 for（类似 JS 的 for...of）</span>
<span class="hljs-type">int</span>[] arr = {<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>};
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-type">int</span> item : arr) {
    System.out.println(item);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// switch（Java 14+ 新写法很好用）</span>
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">result</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">switch</span> (age) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-number">18</span> -&gt; <span class="hljs-string">"成年了"</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span> -&gt; <span class="hljs-string">"小孩"</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> -&gt; <span class="hljs-string">"其他"</span>;
};
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">5. 函数（方法）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// JS：函数是一等公民，可以独立存在</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-params">a, b</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> a + b;
}
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">add2</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">a, b</span>) =&gt; a + b;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Java：方法必须写在类里，且要声明返回类型和参数类型</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">add</span><span class="hljs-params">(<span class="hljs-type">int</span> a, <span class="hljs-type">int</span> b)</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> a + b;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 无返回值用 void</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">printName</span><span class="hljs-params">(String name)</span> {
    System.out.println(name);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 修饰符说明：</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// public  = 访问权限（公开）</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// int     = 返回值类型</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// add     = 方法名</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">四、面向对象：Java 的核心</h3>
<p>JS 也有 class，但 Java 的 OOP 更严格、更体系化。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-12">1. 类与对象</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// JS</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">name, age</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> = name;
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> = age;
    }
    <span class="hljs-title function_">sayHi</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">`我是 <span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.name}</span>`</span>;
    }
}
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> p = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>, <span class="hljs-number">18</span>);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Java</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 成员变量（字段）需要声明类型</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> String name;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> <span class="hljs-type">int</span> age;

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 构造方法（方法名 = 类名，无返回值）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Person</span><span class="hljs-params">(String name, <span class="hljs-type">int</span> age)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">this</span>.name = name;
        <span class="hljs-built_in">this</span>.age = age;
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. getter / setter（Java 习惯用私有字段 + 公开方法访问）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> String <span class="hljs-title function_">getName</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> name;
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setName</span><span class="hljs-params">(String name)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">this</span>.name = name;
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 普通方法</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> String <span class="hljs-title function_">sayHi</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">"我是 "</span> + name;
    }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用</span>
<span class="hljs-type">Person</span> <span class="hljs-variable">p</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>, <span class="hljs-number">18</span>);
System.out.println(p.sayHi());
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-13">2. 访问修饰符（JS 几乎没有的概念）</h4>

























<table><thead><tr><th>修饰符</th><th>含义</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>public</code></td><td>任何地方都能访问</td></tr><tr><td><code>private</code></td><td>只能在本类访问（最常用于字段）</td></tr><tr><td><code>protected</code></td><td>本类 + 子类访问</td></tr><tr><td>不写</td><td>同一个包内访问</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-14">3. 继承</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// extends 关键字（和 JS 一样）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Student</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> String school;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Student</span><span class="hljs-params">(String name, <span class="hljs-type">int</span> age, String school)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">super</span>(name, age);   <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用父类构造，类似 JS 的 super()</span>
        <span class="hljs-built_in">this</span>.school = school;
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// @Override 注解表示重写父类方法</span>
    <span class="hljs-meta">@Override</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> String <span class="hljs-title function_">sayHi</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">"我是学生 "</span> + getName();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-15">4. 接口（重点，JS 里基本没有）</h4>
<p>接口 = 一套规范/契约，只定义"能做什么"，不实现。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// 定义接口</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Animal</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">eat</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span>;            <span class="hljs-comment">// 抽象方法，没有方法体</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sleep</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 实现接口用 implements</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Dog</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">implements</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Animal</span> {
    <span class="hljs-meta">@Override</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">eat</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {
        System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"狗吃骨头"</span>);
    }
    <span class="hljs-meta">@Override</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sleep</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {
        System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"狗睡觉"</span>);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>TS 程序员会很熟悉</strong>：和 TypeScript 的 <code>interface</code> 概念类似，但 Java 接口是运行时真实存在的。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 data-id="heading-16">5. 抽象类</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// 抽象类：介于普通类和接口之间，可以有实现也可以有抽象方法</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">abstract</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Shape</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">abstract</span> <span class="hljs-type">double</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">area</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span>;        <span class="hljs-comment">// 抽象方法，子类必须实现</span>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">print</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {          <span class="hljs-comment">// 普通方法，可直接继承使用</span>
        System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"面积是："</span> + area());
    }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-17">五、集合框架（类似 JS 的数组和对象）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// JS</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> arr = [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>];
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> map = { <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span> };
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> set = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Set</span>([<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>]);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> java.util.*;

<span class="hljs-comment">// List：有序可重复，类似 JS 数组</span>
List&lt;String&gt; list = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ArrayList</span>&lt;&gt;();
list.add(<span class="hljs-string">"a"</span>);
list.add(<span class="hljs-string">"b"</span>);
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">first</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> list.get(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
<span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">size</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> list.size();

<span class="hljs-comment">// Map：键值对，类似 JS 对象/Map</span>
Map&lt;String, Integer&gt; map = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HashMap</span>&lt;&gt;();
map.put(<span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>, <span class="hljs-number">18</span>);
<span class="hljs-type">Integer</span> <span class="hljs-variable">age</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> map.get(<span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// Set：不重复集合</span>
Set&lt;String&gt; set = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HashSet</span>&lt;&gt;();
set.add(<span class="hljs-string">"a"</span>);
set.add(<span class="hljs-string">"a"</span>);  <span class="hljs-comment">// 重复无效</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 遍历 Map</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (Map.Entry&lt;String, Integer&gt; entry : map.entrySet()) {
    System.out.println(entry.getKey() + <span class="hljs-string">":"</span> + entry.getValue());
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">六、泛型（和 TS 泛型类似）</h3>
<p>泛型 = 类型参数化，让代码复用且类型安全。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// TypeScript</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> identity&lt;T&gt;(<span class="hljs-attr">arg</span>: T): T {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> arg;
}
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">list</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>&gt; = [];
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Java 泛型</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 泛型方法</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> &lt;T&gt; T <span class="hljs-title function_">identity</span><span class="hljs-params">(T arg)</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> arg;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 泛型在集合中（最常见）</span>
List&lt;String&gt; names = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ArrayList</span>&lt;&gt;();   <span class="hljs-comment">// 只能放 String</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 自定义泛型类</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Box</span>&lt;T&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> T content;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">set</span><span class="hljs-params">(T content)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">this</span>.content = content;
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> T <span class="hljs-title function_">get</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> content;
    }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用</span>
Box&lt;String&gt; box = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Box</span>&lt;&gt;();
box.set(<span class="hljs-string">"hello"</span>);
<span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">s</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> box.get();
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>后端开发中你会大量见到泛型，比如统一返回结果 <code>Result&lt;User&gt;</code>、分页 <code>Page&lt;Order&gt;</code>。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-19">七、Lambda 与 Stream（前端会爱上的部分）</h3>
<p>Java 8 引入了函数式编程，和 JS 的数组方法极其相似。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// JS</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> nums = [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">4</span>, <span class="hljs-number">5</span>];
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> result = nums
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">n</span> =&gt;</span> n &gt; <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">n</span> =&gt;</span> n * <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">reduce</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a, b</span>) =&gt;</span> a + b, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Java Stream（链式调用，几乎一一对应）</span>
List&lt;Integer&gt; nums = List.of(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">4</span>, <span class="hljs-number">5</span>);
<span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">result</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> nums.stream()
    .filter(n -&gt; n &gt; <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)          <span class="hljs-comment">// 过滤</span>
    .map(n -&gt; n * <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)             <span class="hljs-comment">// 映射</span>
    .reduce(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, Integer::sum);    <span class="hljs-comment">// 归约</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 收集成 List</span>
List&lt;Integer&gt; doubled = nums.stream()
    .map(n -&gt; n * <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)
    .collect(Collectors.toList());

<span class="hljs-comment">// forEach</span>
nums.forEach(n -&gt; System.out.println(n));
</code></pre>





































<table><thead><tr><th>JS 数组方法</th><th>Java Stream</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>.filter()</code></td><td><code>.filter()</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>.map()</code></td><td><code>.map()</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>.reduce()</code></td><td><code>.reduce()</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>.forEach()</code></td><td><code>.forEach()</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>.find()</code></td><td><code>.findFirst()</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>.some()</code></td><td><code>.anyMatch()</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>.every()</code></td><td><code>.allMatch()</code></td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-20">八、异常处理</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// JS</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"出错了"</span>);
} <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (e) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(e.<span class="hljs-property">message</span>);
} <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"结束"</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Java：异常是分类型的</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
    <span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">result</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">10</span> / <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
} <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (ArithmeticException e) {       <span class="hljs-comment">// 捕获特定异常</span>
    System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"除零错误："</span> + e.getMessage());
} <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (Exception e) {                 <span class="hljs-comment">// 兜底</span>
    System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"其他错误"</span>);
} <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
    System.out.println(<span class="hljs-string">"结束"</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 主动抛异常</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RuntimeException</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"自定义错误"</span>);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-21">九、构建工具 Maven（类似 npm）</h3>
<p><code>pom.xml</code> 相当于 <code>package.json</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-xml" lang="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">project</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">groupId</span>&gt;</span>com.example<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">groupId</span>&gt;</span>      <span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 组织名 --&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">artifactId</span>&gt;</span>demo<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">artifactId</span>&gt;</span>       <span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 项目名 --&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">version</span>&gt;</span>1.0.0<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">version</span>&gt;</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 依赖，类似 dependencies --&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">dependencies</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">dependency</span>&gt;</span>
            <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">groupId</span>&gt;</span>org.springframework.boot<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">groupId</span>&gt;</span>
            <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">artifactId</span>&gt;</span>spring-boot-starter-web<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">artifactId</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">dependency</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">dependencies</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">project</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>





















<table><thead><tr><th>Maven 命令</th><th>npm 类比</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>mvn install</code></td><td><code>npm install</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>mvn package</code></td><td><code>npm run build</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>mvn test</code></td><td><code>npm test</code></td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>Maven 会从中央仓库下载 jar 包到本地 <code>.m2</code> 目录（类似 node_modules，但全局共享）。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-22">十、核心框架介绍</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-23">框架是干什么的？</h4>








































<table><thead><tr><th>框架</th><th>作用</th><th>前端类比</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>Spring</strong></td><td>整个生态的核心，管理对象、解耦</td><td>类似 Angular 的依赖注入体系</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Spring Boot</strong></td><td>简化 Spring 配置，开箱即用</td><td>类似 create-react-app / Vite 脚手架</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Spring MVC</strong></td><td>处理 HTTP 请求，写接口</td><td>类似 Express 的路由</td></tr><tr><td><strong>MyBatis / MyBatis-Plus</strong></td><td>操作数据库</td><td>类似 Prisma / TypeORM</td></tr><tr><td><strong>MySQL</strong></td><td>关系型数据库</td><td>数据存储</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Redis</strong></td><td>内存缓存</td><td>缓存数据</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-24">核心概念：IoC 与依赖注入</h4>
<p>这是 Spring 的灵魂。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 传统方式：自己 new 对象</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserService</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userDao</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserDao</span>();  <span class="hljs-comment">// 自己创建依赖</span>
    }
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Spring：由容器创建和注入对象，你只管"要"</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@Service</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserService</span> {
    <span class="hljs-meta">@Autowired</span>               <span class="hljs-comment">// 自动注入，不用自己 new</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> UserDao userDao;
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>理解</strong>：Spring 帮你管理所有对象（叫 Bean），需要的时候自动"喂"给你，让代码解耦。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-25">十一、Spring Boot 快速上手</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-26">1. 创建项目</h4>
<p>访问 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fstart.spring.io" target="_blank" title="https://start.spring.io" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">start.spring.io</a>，选择：</p>
<ul>
<li>Project: Maven</li>
<li>Language: Java</li>
<li>依赖勾选：<code>Spring Web</code>、<code>MyBatis Framework</code>、<code>MySQL Driver</code></li>
</ul>
<p>下载后用 IDEA 打开。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-27">2. 项目结构</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">src/main/java/com/example/demo/
├── DemoApplication.java      <span class="hljs-comment"># 启动入口（类似 main.js）</span>
├── controller/               <span class="hljs-comment"># 接口层（类似路由）</span>
├── service/                  <span class="hljs-comment"># 业务逻辑层</span>
├── mapper/                   <span class="hljs-comment"># 数据库操作层</span>
└── entity/                   <span class="hljs-comment"># 数据模型（类似 model）</span>

src/main/resources/
└── application.yml           <span class="hljs-comment"># 配置文件（类似 .env + config）</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-28">3. 启动类</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-meta">@SpringBootApplication</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DemoApplication</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">main</span><span class="hljs-params">(String[] args)</span> {
        SpringApplication.run(DemoApplication.class, args);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-29">4. 写一个接口（对比 Express）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// Express</span>
app.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/user/:id'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">req, res</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: req.<span class="hljs-property">params</span>.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span> });
});
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// Spring MVC</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@RestController</span>                          <span class="hljs-comment">// 声明这是接口控制器</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@RequestMapping("/user")</span>                 <span class="hljs-comment">// 路由前缀</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserController</span> {

    <span class="hljs-meta">@GetMapping("/{id}")</span>                 <span class="hljs-comment">// GET /user/{id}</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> User <span class="hljs-title function_">getUser</span><span class="hljs-params">(<span class="hljs-meta">@PathVariable</span> Long id)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-type">User</span> <span class="hljs-variable">user</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">User</span>();
        user.setId(id);
        user.setName(<span class="hljs-string">"张三"</span>);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> user;                     <span class="hljs-comment">// 自动转成 JSON</span>
    }

    <span class="hljs-meta">@PostMapping</span>                         <span class="hljs-comment">// POST /user</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> String <span class="hljs-title function_">create</span><span class="hljs-params">(<span class="hljs-meta">@RequestBody</span> User user)</span> {  <span class="hljs-comment">// 接收 JSON body</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">"创建成功："</span> + user.getName();
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 接收查询参数 ?name=xxx</span>
    <span class="hljs-meta">@GetMapping("/search")</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> String <span class="hljs-title function_">search</span><span class="hljs-params">(<span class="hljs-meta">@RequestParam</span> String name)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">"搜索："</span> + name;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>常用注解对照：</p>





























<table><thead><tr><th>Spring 注解</th><th>作用</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>@RestController</code></td><td>标记接口类，返回 JSON</td></tr><tr><td><code>@GetMapping/@PostMapping</code></td><td>对应 HTTP 方法</td></tr><tr><td><code>@PathVariable</code></td><td>路径参数 <code>/user/1</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>@RequestParam</code></td><td>查询参数 <code>?name=x</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>@RequestBody</code></td><td>请求体 JSON</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-30">5. 配置数据库</h4>
<p><code>application.yml</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-yaml" lang="yaml"><span class="hljs-attr">server:</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">port:</span> <span class="hljs-number">8080</span>

<span class="hljs-attr">spring:</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">datasource:</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">url:</span> <span class="hljs-string">jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/test</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">username:</span> <span class="hljs-string">root</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">password:</span> <span class="hljs-number">123456</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">driver-class-name:</span> <span class="hljs-string">com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-31">6. MyBatis-Plus 操作数据库（推荐入门）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 实体类，对应数据库表</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@Data</span>                              <span class="hljs-comment">// Lombok 注解，自动生成 getter/setter</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@TableName("user")</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">User</span> {
    <span class="hljs-meta">@TableId</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> Long id;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> String name;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> Integer age;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. Mapper 接口，继承后自动拥有增删改查</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserMapper</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BaseMapper</span>&lt;User&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 基础 CRUD 都内置了，复杂查询才需要自己写</span>
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 在 Service 中使用</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@Service</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserService</span> {
    <span class="hljs-meta">@Autowired</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> UserMapper userMapper;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> User <span class="hljs-title function_">getById</span><span class="hljs-params">(Long id)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> userMapper.selectById(id);     <span class="hljs-comment">// 内置方法，直接查</span>
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">add</span><span class="hljs-params">(User user)</span> {
        userMapper.insert(user);              <span class="hljs-comment">// 内置插入</span>
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> List&lt;User&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">list</span><span class="hljs-params">()</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> userMapper.selectList(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);   <span class="hljs-comment">// 查全部</span>
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-32">7. 完整调用链</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown">HTTP 请求
<span class="hljs-code">    ↓
Controller（接收参数）
    ↓
Service（业务逻辑）
    ↓
Mapper（数据库操作）
    ↓
MySQL
</span></code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-33">十二、学习建议与实战路径</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-34">推荐第一个练手项目：用户管理系统</h4>
<p>实现这些功能，把上面知识串起来：</p>
<ol>
<li>用户的增删改查接口（CRUD）</li>
<li>分页查询</li>
<li>统一返回结果封装</li>
<li>全局异常处理</li>
<li>用 Postman 测试接口</li>
</ol>
<h4 data-id="heading-35">统一返回结果（实战必备）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// 用泛型封装统一返回格式</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@Data</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Result</span>&lt;T&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> <span class="hljs-type">int</span> code;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> String message;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> T data;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> &lt;T&gt; Result&lt;T&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">success</span><span class="hljs-params">(T data)</span> {
        Result&lt;T&gt; result = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Result</span>&lt;&gt;();
        result.code = <span class="hljs-number">200</span>;
        result.message = <span class="hljs-string">"成功"</span>;
        result.data = data;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> result;
    }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@GetMapping("/{id}")</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> Result&lt;User&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">getUser</span><span class="hljs-params">(<span class="hljs-meta">@PathVariable</span> Long id)</span> {
    <span class="hljs-type">User</span> <span class="hljs-variable">user</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> userService.getById(id);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> Result.success(user);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-36">学习顺序总结</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown"><span class="hljs-bullet">1.</span> 先把语法部分敲一遍（1周）—— 重点：类、接口、集合、泛型、Stream
<span class="hljs-bullet">2.</span> 搭一个 Spring Boot 项目跑通 Hello World
<span class="hljs-bullet">3.</span> 写第一个 GET 接口，用 Postman 调通
<span class="hljs-bullet">4.</span> 接数据库，实现完整 CRUD
<span class="hljs-bullet">5.</span> 完善：分页、异常处理、参数校验
<span class="hljs-bullet">6.</span> 进阶：Redis 缓存、登录鉴权(JWT)、文件上传
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-37">给前端的几条心法</h4>
<ol>
<li><strong>拥抱类型系统</strong>：刚开始觉得啰嗦，但它能帮你在编译期发现错误，写惯了 TS 的话很快适应。</li>
<li><strong>理解"一切都在类里"</strong>：Java 没有游离的函数，所有代码都在类的方法里。</li>
<li><strong>Spring 的核心是 IoC</strong>：先用起来，不用一开始就深究原理。</li>
<li><strong>善用 IDEA</strong>：自动补全、自动导包、重构功能极强，比手敲快很多。</li>
<li><strong>Lombok 必装</strong>：<code>@Data</code> 注解省去大量 getter/setter 样板代码。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-38">结语</h3>
<p>作为前端，JS/TS 经验会大大加速 Java 学习。最大的门槛是<strong>静态类型思维</strong>和<strong>面向对象的体系化设计</strong>。先动手把一个 CRUD 项目跑通，比看一百遍教程都管用。</p></div></div>
